steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Level sensor hose
steps.body: Inspect hose to water level sensor — torn, hole, or frozen. Defrost if winter.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect hose to water level sensor — torn, hole, or frozen. Defrost if winter.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace level sensor hose; defrost if frozen.

steps.title: Restart after spin
steps.body: Restart cycle after spin. If OC remains, replace water level sensor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restart cycle after spin. If OC remains, replace water level sensor.

steps.title: Repair hose
steps.oemOutcome: Correct hose damage or freezing condition.

steps.title: Overflow resolved
steps.oemOutcome: OC cleared — monitor level sensor if recurrence.
